comment: wizcmds.c wiz_intrinsic() 1004-1007: the menu count is a long that C stores with an (int) cast, so only its low 32 bits count. A debug-mode dwarf Valkyrie selects stunned with count 4294967296 (int 0) and confused with 2147483648 (int -2147483648), which both take the 'amt <= 0' continue at 1007 with no message, and hallucinating with 4294967326 (int 30), then #timeout lists only hallucinating at 30. Seed, date, character and inputs were chosen independently of every recorded session.
